preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the size n of the arrays must be between 5 and 500.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(arr) == n for arr in arrays)
preconditions.description: Each of the 2n arrays must have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(set(arr) == set(range(1, n + 1)) for arr in arrays)
preconditions.description: Each array must be a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the count of good subsets modulo 998244353 followed by the indices of one good subset.
The count of good subsets must be non-negative.
The number of indices in the output must be exactly n.
